2110378081001369775.en_summary: @UrbanKaoboy: everyone wants yields lower, but the likeliest path back to 2% to 3% fed funds is a brutal economic and market bust.

2110377212348076326.en_summary: @robin_j_brooks: the IMF forecasts Iran's 2026 average growth at -7.6%, implying GDP in Q4 2026 down something like 14% from Q4 2025.
2110377212348076326.zh_summary: @robin_j_brooks：IMF預測伊朗2026年平均增長-7.6%，意味2026年第四季GDP較2025年第四季下跌約14%。
2110377212348076326.ko_summary: @robin_j_brooks: IMF는 이란의 2026년 평균 성장률을 -7.6%로 예측하며 이는 2026년 4분기 GDP가 2025년 4분기 대비 약 14% 줄었다는 뜻이다.

2110376832742707253.en_summary: (Reposted by @carlquintanilla) @byHeatherLong: inflation has nearly wiped out wage gains since Jan 2025, with CPI +5.4% and average hourly earnings +5.5%, versus wages up over 15% in Trump's first term.
